relevance.rationale: Foundational template theorem projecting knotted periodic orbits of 3d hyperbolic dynamical flows onto branched 2-manifold knot-holders carrying positive braid words.

keyResults.statement: Quotienting a hyperbolic 3-flow chain-recurrent set along local stable manifolds produces a branched 2-manifold template preserving the isotopy link type of all periodic orbits.
keyResults.useForFolio: Supplies the template-projection bridge from 3d geodesic/Reeb-like flows to positive-braid words in rem:braid-fluid.
